40022790.author: पदार्थः
40022790.content: तथा thus, उक्तवति having spoken, रामे Rama, तु but, तस्य his (Pururavas's), जन्म birth, तत् that, अद्भुतम् wonderful, उवाच spoke, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, भूयः again, भरतः Bharata, च and, महायशाः highly renowned.

40022790.author: Translation
40022790.content: When Rama had thus spoken about that wonderful birth of Pururavas, Lakshmana and the highly renowned Bharata spoke again.

40022791.author: पदार्थः
40022791.content: इला Ila, सा she, सोमपुत्रस्य of the son of Soma (Budha), संवत्सरम् for a year, अथ then, उषिता having resided, अकरोत् did, किं what, नरश्रेष्ठ O best of men, तत्त्वं the truth, शंसितुम् to tell, अर्हसि you ought.

40022791.author: Translation
40022791.content: O best of men, you ought to tell us the truth about what Ila did after she resided with Budha, the son of Soma, for a year.

40022792.author: पदार्थः
40022792.content: tayoḥ of those two, tat that, vākyamādhuryam sweetness of speech, niśamya having heard, paripṛcchatoḥ who were asking, rāmaḥ Rama, punar again, uvāca said, imām this, prajāpatisute O daughter of Prajapati, kathām story.

40022792.author: Translation
40022792.content: Having heard the sweet words of those two who were questioning, Rama again told this story, O daughter of Prajapati.

40022793.author: पदार्थः
40022793.content: puruṣatvam manhood, gate having attained, śūre the brave one, budhaḥ Budha, paramabuddhimān extremely intelligent, saṃvartam Samvarta, paramodāram extremely generous, ājuhāva invited, mahāyaśāḥ highly renowned.

40022793.author: Translation
40022793.content: When the brave one (Ila/Sudyumna) attained manhood, the highly renowned and extremely intelligent Budha invited the exceedingly generous sage Samvarta.

40022794.author: पदार्थः
40022794.content: cyavanam Chyavana, bhṛguputram son of Bhrigu, ca and, munim sage, ca and, ariṣṭaneminam Arishtanemi, pramodanam Pramodana, modakaram who causes joy, tataḥ then, durvāsasam Durvasas, munim sage.

40022794.author: Translation
40022794.content: He also invited Chyavana, the son of Bhrigu, the sage Arishtanemi, Pramodana who brings joy, and then the sage Durvasas.

40022795.author: पदार्थः
40022795.content: etān these, sarvān all, samānīya having gathered, vākyajñaḥ one who knows speech, tattvadarśanaḥ one who sees the truth, uvāca said, sarvān to all, suhṛdaḥ friends, dhairyeṇa with patience, susamāhitān well-composed.

40022795.author: Translation
40022795.content: Having gathered all these, the eloquent and perceptive Budha spoke to all his well-composed friends with patience.

40022796.author: पदार्थः
40022796.content: ayam this, rājā king, mahābāhuḥ mighty-armed, kardamasya of Kardama, ilaḥ Ila, sutaḥ son, jānīta know, enam him, yathābhūtam as he truly is, śreyaḥ welfare, hi indeed, atra in this matter, vidhīyatām let it be done.

40022796.author: Translation
40022796.content: He said, "This mighty-armed king, Ila, is the son of Kardama; know him as he truly is, and indeed, let his welfare be ensured in this matter."

40022797.author: पदार्थः
40022797.content: तेषां of them, संवदताम् conversing, एव just, तम् that, आश्रमम् hermitage, उपागमत् approached, कर्दमः Kardama, तु and, महातेजाः highly effulgent, द्विजैः with brahmins, सह together with, महात्मभिः great-souled ones

40022797.author: Translation
40022797.content: Just as they were conversing, the greatly refulgent Kardama approached that hermitage along with other great-souled brahmins.

40022798.author: पदार्थः
40022798.content: पुलस्त्यः Pulastya, च and, क्रतुः Kratu, च and, एव indeed, वषट्कारः Vaṣaṭkāra, तथा similarly, एव indeed, च and, ओङ्कारः Oṅkāra, च and, महातेजाः highly effulgent, तम् that, आश्रमम् hermitage, उपागमत् approached

40022798.author: Translation
40022798.content: Pulastya, Kratu, Vaṣaṭkāra, and the greatly effulgent Oṅkāra also similarly approached that hermitage.

40022799.author: पदार्थः
40022799.content: ते they, सर्वे all, हृष्टमनसः with joyful minds, परस्परसमागमे at their mutual meeting, हितैषिणः well-wishers, बाल्हिपतेः of the king of Bālhika, पृथक् separately, वाक्यानि words, अथ then, अब्रुवन् spoke

40022799.author: Translation
40022799.content: All of them, delighted at their mutual meeting and being well-wishers of the king of Bālhika, then spoke different words.

40022800.author: पदार्थः
40022800.content: कर्दमः Kardama, तु and, अब्रवीत् spoke, वाक्यम् words, सुतार्थम् for the sake of a son, परमम् supreme, हितम् beneficial, द्विजाः O brahmins, शृणुत listen, मद्वाक्यम् my words, यत् which, श्रेयः welfare, पार्थिवस्य of the king, हि indeed

40022800.author: Translation
40022800.content: Kardama then spoke words that were supremely beneficial for the sake of a son, saying, "O brahmins, listen to my words which are indeed for the welfare of the king."

40022801.author: पदार्थः
40022801.content: न not, अन्यम् other, पश्यामि I see, भैषज्यम् remedy, अन्तरा without, वृषभध्वजम् Lord Shiva, न not, अश्वमेधात् than the Ashvamedha sacrifice, परः superior, यज्ञः sacrifice, प्रियः dear, च and, एव indeed, महात्मनः to the great-souled one, तस्मात् therefore, यजामहे let us sacrifice, सर्वे all, पार्थिवार्थे for the sake of the king, दुरासदम् formidable

40022801.author: Translation
40022801.content: I see no other remedy except Lord Shiva, and there is no sacrifice superior to the Ashvamedha, which is indeed dear to the great-souled one; therefore, let us all perform the formidable Ashvamedha sacrifice for the sake of the king.

40022802.author: पदार्थः
40022802.content: कर्दमेनैव by Kardama thus, उक्ताः spoken, तु indeed, सर्वे all, एव indeed, द्विजर्षभाः best among Brahmins, रोचयन्ति स्म approved, तम् that, यज्ञम् sacrifice, रुद्रस्य of Rudra, आराधनम् worship, प्रति for.

40022802.author: Translation
40022802.content: All the eminent Brahmins, thus addressed by Kardama, approved of that sacrifice intended for the worship of Rudra.

40022803.author: पदार्थः
40022803.content: संवर्तस्य of Samvarta, तु indeed, राजर्षेः of the royal sage, शिष्यः disciple, पुरपुरञ्जयः conqueror of cities, मरुत्तः Marutta, इति thus, विख्यातः renowned, तम् that, यज्ञम् sacrifice, समुपाहरत् performed.

40022803.author: Translation
40022803.content: The renowned Marutta, a disciple of the royal sage Samvarta and a conqueror of cities, then performed that sacrifice.

40022804.author: पदार्थः
40022804.content: ततः then, यज्ञः sacrifice, महान् great, आसीत् was, बुधाश्रमसमीपतः near Budha's hermitage, रुद्रः Rudra, च and, परमम् supreme, तोषम् satisfaction, आजगाम attained, महायशाः highly renowned.

40022804.author: Translation
40022804.content: A great sacrifice then took place near Budha's hermitage, and the highly renowned Rudra attained supreme satisfaction.

40022805.author: पदार्थः
40022805.content: अथ then, यज्ञे समाप्ते when the sacrifice was concluded, उमापतिः the lord of Uma, प्रीतः pleased, परमया मुदा with supreme joy, इलसन्निधौ in Ila's presence, सर्वान् द्विजान् all the brahmins, उवाच addressed.

40022805.author: Translation
40022805.content: Then, when the sacrifice was concluded, the lord of Uma, pleased and filled with supreme joy, addressed all the brahmins there in Ila's presence.

40022806.author: पदार्थः
40022806.content: प्रीतः pleased, अस्मि I am, हयमेधेन by the horse sacrifice, भक्त्या by devotion, च and, द्विजसत्तमाः O best among Brahmins, अस्य of this, बाह्लिपतेः of the lord of Bahlika, च and, एव indeed, किम् what, करोमि shall I do, प्रियम् pleasing, शुभम् auspicious.

40022806.author: Translation
40022806.content: Rudra declared, "O best among Brahmins, I am pleased by this horse sacrifice and by your devotion; what pleasing and auspicious thing shall I do for this lord of Bahlika?"

40022807.author: पदार्थः
40022807.content: तथा thus, वदति speaking, देवेशे when the lord of gods, द्विजाः Brahmins, ते those, सुसमाहिताः well-composed, प्रसादयन्ति propitiated, देवेशम् the lord of gods, यथा so that, स्यात् may become, पुरुषः a man, तु indeed, इला Ila.

40022807.author: Translation
40022807.content: When the lord of gods spoke thus, those attentive Brahmins propitiated him so that Ila might indeed become a man again.

40022808.author: पदार्थः
40022808.content: ततः then, प्रीतो pleased, महादेवः Mahadeva, पुरुषत्वं manhood, ददौ gave, पुनः again, इलायै to Ila, सुमहातेजा of great splendor, दत्त्वा having given, च and, अन्तरधीयत disappeared.

40022808.author: Translation
40022808.content: Then, the greatly effulgent Mahadeva, being pleased, restored Ila to manhood, and having done so, he disappeared.

40022809.author: पदार्थः
40022809.content: निवृत्ते having concluded, हयमेधे the horse sacrifice, च and, गतश्च went and, अदर्शनं out of sight, हरः Hara, यथागतं as they had come, द्विजाः Brahmins, सर्वे all, हि indeed, अगच्छन् went, दीर्घदर्शिनः far-sighted ones.

40022809.author: Translation
40022809.content: After the horse sacrifice was concluded, Hara disappeared, and all the wise Brahmins returned to their respective places as they had come.

40022810.author: पदार्थः
40022810.content: राजा the king, तु but, बाह्लिम् Bahli, उत्सृज्य having abandoned, मध्यदेशे in the central region, हि indeed, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed, निवेशयामास established, पुरं a city, प्रतिष्ठानं Pratishthana, यशस्करम् glorious.

40022810.author: Translation
40022810.content: But the king, having left Bahli, established the glorious and unsurpassed city of Pratishthana in the central region.

40022811.author: पदार्थः
40022811.content: शशबिन्दुः Shashabindu, च and, राजर्षिः royal sage, बाह्लिम् Bahli, पुरपुरञ्जयः conqueror of cities, प्रतिष्ठाने in Pratishthana, इलः Ila, राजा king, प्रजापतिसुतः son of Prajapati, बली powerful.

40022811.author: Translation
40022811.content: The royal sage Shashabindu, a conqueror of cities, ruled Bahli, while the powerful King Ila, son of Prajapati, ruled in Pratishthana.

40022812.author: पदार्थः
40022812.content: सः he, काले in time, प्राप्तवान् attained, लोकम् world, इलः Ila, ब्राह्मम् of Brahma, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed, ऐलः Aila, पुरूरवा Pururava, राजा king, प्रतिष्ठानम् Pratishthana, अवाप्तवान् obtained.

40022812.author: Translation
40022812.content: In due course, King Ila attained the unsurpassed divine realm of Brahma, and his son, King Pururava Aila, then obtained Pratishthana.

40022813.author: पदार्थः
40022813.content: ईदृशः such, हि indeed, अश्वमेधस्य of the Ashwamedha sacrifice, प्रभावः power, पुरुषर्षभौ O best among men, स्त्रीभूतः having become a woman, पौरुषं manhood, लेभे obtained, यत् च and what, अन्यत् अपि other also, दुर्लभम् difficult to obtain.

40022813.author: Translation
40022813.content: Indeed, such is the power of the Ashwamedha sacrifice, O best among men, that one who had become a woman regained manhood and obtained other things that are difficult to achieve. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे नवतितमः सर्गः ।। 90 ।। Thus ends the ninetieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
